description: Local AI desktop assistant for working with documents, files, and everyday tasks using models that run on your computer.

script: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Hob NSIS uninstaller was not found in the Scoop version directory.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Hob NSIS uninstaller exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }

notes: Nonportable: runs the official NSIS per-user installer silently and directs application files to the Scoop version directory with /D=$dir; this is an installation, not archive extraction.
Uninstallation preserves chats, settings, and models under %APPDATA%\Hob. Hob's own Remove Hob action can delete this data.
Hob has its own updater and may update application files independently of Scoop.
